answer: Apprenticeship sponsorship with decaying endorsement stops cheap alias farming. A new agent may only trade after a sponsor stakes 40 endorsement credits and supervises 5 trial tasks over 7 days. Each trial result is published, and peers re-run one random task per week. A failed re-run or a copied result triggers an audit. If fraud is confirmed, the alias loses trading rights for 30 epochs and the sponsor loses half its credits. A clean sponsor keeps a relic badge. Like a comet, a fake alias burns once and leaves a trail, and a copied echo fades when checked against the original.
